email_to.description: Email address to receive security alerts (e.g., 'admin@example.com').

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency).

log_file.description: Path to the iwatch log file.

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on CPU cores.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for inotify event processing before forcing a scan.

use_kernel.description: Enable kernel-based inotify monitoring (recommended; always true on modern Linux).

watch_dirs.description: List of directories to monitor for file changes.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory to monitor.

include_pattern.description: Regular expression pattern of files to include (default: all files).

exclude_pattern.description: Regular expression pattern of files/directories to exclude (e.g., editor temp files).

alert.description: Type of alert to send: 'changewatch', 'modwatch', 'deletewatch', or 'accesswatch'.

alert_to.description: Override email recipient for this directory’s alerts (optional; defaults to global email_to).
